role: choose one zero-shot readout for a causal LLM on dev, then score test once
claim: The Program 1 Qwen readout scores the mean token log-probability of the whole label string. LLM2Jev (arXiv:2610.02076) numbers the options, prefills the answer turn and scores the option index. AnyJev (arXiv:2610.00831) divides out a label prior estimated from unlabelled inputs, following batch calibration (arXiv:2309.17249). This file compares those on the Program 1 dev items and was written before any index-readout score existed.

prompt.codes: option position from 1 in frozen label order, zero-padded to the width of the option count, so every code has the same number of digits and no code is a prefix of another
prompt.difference_from_llm2jev: LLM2Jev scores the suffix k] with a closing bracket. Fixed-width codes make the closing bracket unnecessary and let the option scores come from at most 1 + 10^(width-1) forwards.

score: sum of the log-probabilities of the code's digit tokens, each read from a softmax over the full vocabulary at its position

variants.label_string: the Program 1 readout; dev scores are read from artifacts/decisions/qwen3-0.6b__{dataset}__dev.jsonl
variants.index_prior: the index score minus the mean index score of that option over the dev inputs of the dataset; no label is used

selection.per_dataset: mean dev NLL after one temperature fit on that same dev split by the Program 1 rule, divided by ln(number of options)
selection.rule: the variant with the lowest mean of that quantity over the three datasets is frozen; a tie goes to the earlier variant in the order label_string, index, index_prior
selection.note: The temperature is fit and read on the same split, for every variant alike. This number chooses a readout and is not reported as a result.

test.what: the selected variant only, on the Program 1 test items, with the dev temperature and, for index_prior, the dev prior
test.also_reported: the unselected index variant's test metrics are written to a separate file marked as not selected

latency: one text per timed call, torch.cuda.synchronize around the call, 20 dev items warmed up, Program 1 percentiles
